name: Paper Guitar
source:
Paper Guitar is a romance about a fret-boy named Freddy Fretstop and his love, Watts, together they find love and adventure in the small hamlet town of Paper Guitarra, home to few from Lectro and Cithara. With characters inspired from the most obscure of everyday things like light switches and guitar necks, their is a talking pick too who is out to rock the world!

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=23145]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
